paragraphs: (Ritzpah daughter of Ayah, II Samuel 21:5.) See the entry Acha bar Chadya.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The Biblical namesake is cited as II Samuel 21:5; Ritzpah daughter of Ayah is named in II Samuel 3:7 and 21:8–11.

Hyman’s supplied II Samuel 21:5 is retained in the body, alongside the existing note. The named Miqra according to the Masorah II Samuel 21:8 verse explicitly names Ritzpah daughter of Ayah. The note’s additional references are not all freshly collated here. The Acha bar Chadya pointer is translated literally; no identity or family relationship to the Biblical namesake is inferred.
